Nina: Need assets for the mid-Q3 launch: hero banner, three micro-benchmark tiles, routing mini-diagram, webinar slide. Due Fri EOD.
Mira: Understood. What metrics for the tiles?
Nina: Hosted p50=88ms cost=$0.0024; Dedicated p50=64ms cost=$0.0015; Private p50=70ms cost=$0.0020. Callout: Dedicated most cost-efficient at scale.
Jackie: Brand: new tokens (navy/coral/muted-olive). Type: Inter. Icons: flat two-tone. Keep max 3 numbers per tile + one-line insight.
Omar: Routing: score>=60 -> SDR queue + slack alert; <60 -> 7-day nurture drip. Use color-coded paths.
Mira: Deliverables: Figma (pages: hero, tiles, routing), PNGs 1200x628 + 640x360 + 1920x1080. Localized layers for en-US/en-GB.
Nina: Legal note: avoid "cheapest". Include footnote: "Based on internal Redwood tests, June 2025." @Jackie will add exact wording.
design-bot: Checklist created: [Figma master, PNG 1200x628, PNG 640x360, PNG 1920x1080, SVG icons, localizable text layers, export manifest].
Mira: First drafts Thu AM, final Fri EOD. Will post figma link when ready.
Nina: Thanks team, please comment in Figma rather than long Slack threads. :rocket:
